name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role or class colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

added: Buffs & Debuffs now starts with a useful selection: the four Battle Imagine lockout debuffs (Mechanical Failure, Element Stasis, Time Stasis, Weakened: Wish Sealed) plus every Potion and Cuisine buff, set to show only checked. If you never customised Buffs & Debuffs, you will now see these too. Anything you already saved stays as you set it.
fixed: Open-world fights between two dungeon runs no longer upload as a fake dungeon clear and no longer borrow the next dungeon's run. They stay in your local history and are not uploaded.
